title: Replace a fault-marked module and preserve healthy modules
instruction: Replace the red-marked middle module with the blue spare. Put the removed module in the collection tray. Keep both green modules seated and finish with the retaining bar installed.

scoring: Each of 3 outcome conditions earns 1/3; all conditions and numeric tolerances are listed in README.md and scene.json. Full score requires all conditions, all task bodies at <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, conservative robot clearance >=0.02 m for one continuous second. Before the hold completes, credit is capped at 0.95. Any lost part, fixture displacement, violated preservation invariant or penetration above 0.002 m permanently scores zero.
run_limit: 3600 controls at 20 Hz (180 simulated seconds), provisional budget
reset_notes: Reset the native environment, restore every body and joint to scene.json, settle, then clear scorer history. Two independent full-score trials remain required.
fidelity: Engineering draft; unvalidated rigid primitives and passive joints. This candidate is too close to existing visible-fault drive replacement tasks and is not selected for submission.
